reproduction.summary: v0.1.0 release of resident-engineer. The full contribution loop runs end to end: doctrine reader (extractor+fetch) reads a real repo's AGENTS.md, TaskAdmission rejects unclear tasks, VerificationCourt fails on critical checks, run_contribution wires admission->brain->route->cell->court->PR, consult_brain blocks conflicting approaches, apply_pr_outcome folds merged/rejected results into the brain. CLI (brain|contribute|show) is fail-closed and --no-brain stays offline.

duplicateCheck.result: no prior tags or releases; v0.1.0 is the first
